Against that: net flow over the last 15 minutes is -6 SOL, with sells (159 SOL) outpacing buys, and the sell-to-buy ratio post-graduation is 1.07. Return is -31% over 15 minutes and -66% over 30. The pool is only 48.8 SOL deep, so a $20 round trip faces the high end of the impact range, and bundle share of 36% suggests coordinated early buying. Nothing in the brief shows demand rebuilding; the buying pressure is being absorbed by sellers.

Verdict: no strong case to buy. The organic structure and continued buyer count are the best points, but a falling, net-selling coin 31 minutes old is squarely in the base-rate losing zone. Skip.
